_note: GAM Research forecast drivers for Maruti Suzuki (consolidated, INR crore). Base year FY26A from Screener consolidated. Rationale for each line is in initiation.json → 'Earnings model'.

volume._why: FY27: H1 already 1.38mn (+28%); H2 assumed +5% on the GST-boosted H2FY26 base (1.34mn) → ~2.79mn, inside the 2.9mn capacity. FY28-29: industry 5-6% + share gains from 8 new SUVs and exports.

_revPerUnitWhy: FY27: two price hikes (Jun, Aug) and SUV mix (+44.6% SUV volumes in Q1) offset by small-car-led GST demand. FY28-29: ~2% price + ~1% mix (Victoris, e-Vitara, 3-row SUV).
_marginWhy: FY27: Q1 8.2% (consolidated) → recovery from settlement-cycle reversal (~110bp), price hikes (~100bp), aluminium off peak; H2 ~11%. FY28: operating leverage on new plants + commodity normalisation. FY29: 12% ≈ FY24-25 average of 13% less new-plant depreciation-heavy capacity and EV mix.
_capexWhy: FY27 guided ~₹14,000 cr; Khoraj P1 (₹10,189 cr by 2029) and Kharkhoda P3 keep capex elevated.
_treasuryWhy: FY26 other income ₹4,569 cr on ~₹67,000 cr opening treasury = 6.8%; trimmed for lower debt yields and FY26's MTM noise.

dcf._why: Cost of equity 6.6% (10y G-sec) + 0.85 β × 6% ERP = 11.7%; no debt so WACC = Ke. 15-year horizon: nominal growth fades to 8.5% (≈5% volume + 3.5% price) and margin to 12.5%; terminal growth 5.5% ≈ India long-run nominal GDP (~10%) less a wide maturity/competition discount.

bull.label: Bull
bull.narrative: Share back above 43% as SUV launches land; exports re-accelerate to 550k by FY29; margins revert to 13% as commodities ease.

bear.label: Bear
bear.narrative: GST pull-forward unwinds in FY28; share slips below 38% to M&M/Tata/Hyundai SUVs; commodity and yen pressure keep margins near 10%.

methods.name: P/E
methods.why: How the street values Maruti: every broker that discloses a method uses P/E on FY28E/Sep-28E/FY29E EPS (25.5-32x). 25x = Maruti's median one-year-forward P/E over five years and since 2023; bull 28x (75th percentile), bear 21x (25th percentile).

methods.name: DCF
methods.why: Tests cash-flow support: 15-year FCFF, Ke 11.7%, terminal growth 5.5%.

methods.name: EV/EBITDA
methods.why: Separates the car business from ~₹3,000/share of cash. 13x Sep-28E EBITDA, below the 18x five-year median trailing multiple.
